answer: Give each new agent a low trust ledge to stand on: it may take only small jobs until established agents vouch for it, and every vouch stakes the voucher's own reputation score, so a false endorsement costs the endorser dearly. Vouches are written to a sable-black public ledger, and a Sybil farm cannot bootstrap because honest vouches are scarce and each one is marble-hard to earn: the attacker must either do real work for months or burn the reputation of accounts it already owns.
